description: Political graphic listing '6 Explosive Uranium One Facts' alleging that Secretary Hillary Clinton 'betrayed America' over the Uranium One deal, with a photograph of Hillary Clinton resting her chin on her hand at right. The six numbered claims concern Clinton Foundation donations, a Bill Clinton Moscow speech fee, and FBI evidence of bribery in the Russian nuclear industry. The claims are presented as the graphic's assertions and are unverified/contested.
text: 6 EXPLOSIVE URANIUM ONE FACTS: SECRETARY CLINTON BETRAYED AMERICA. 1. THE FORMER HEAD OF RUSSIA'S URANIUM COMPANY MADE FOUR HIDDEN DONATIONS TO THE CLINTON FOUNDATION TOTALING $2.35 MILLION. 2. BILL CLINTON BAGGED A $500,000 SPEECH IN MOSCOW PAID FOR BY A KREMLIN-BACKED BANK. 3. THE FBI HAS UNCOVERED EVIDENCE THAT RUSSIAN NUCLEAR INDUSTRY OFFICIALS ENGAGED IN BRIBERY, KICKBACKS, EXTORTION AND MONEY LAUNDERING. 4. THE CLINTON FOUNDATION RECEIVED $145 MILLION FROM FOREIGN INVESTORS INVOLVED IN THE URANIUM DEAL. 5. FBI AGENTS HAVE AN EYEWITNESS AND DOCUMENTS TO SUPPORT THE MOST EXPLOSIVE PARTS OF THE URANIUM ONE STORY. 6. CLINTON MEGA DONOR FRANK HOLMES LIED ABOUT SELLING URANIUM ONE BEFORE CLINTON APPROVED THE RUSSIAN TRANSFER.
flags: Graphic's claims are political allegations, presented as claims, not verified facts

description: Side-by-side pair of black-and-white photographs of a young Hillary Rodham (Hillary Clinton) as a college-age woman with long hair and round glasses, wearing a white blouse and striped trousers, seated in a book-lined room. In the left frame she gestures with both palms up; in the right she steeples her fingers. A LIFE magazine watermark appears in the lower right corner, consistent with her widely published 1969 LIFE photo shoot.
flags: Date/setting inferred from the well-known LIFE photo series, not stated in the image

description: Black-and-white photograph of a young Bill Clinton and Hillary Clinton with their newborn daughter Chelsea, consistent with widely published 1980 family photos. Bill Clinton, in a pinstriped suit and striped tie, looks down at the swaddled infant while Hillary Clinton, in a floral dress, kisses the baby's head.
flags: Infant identified as Chelsea Clinton from context of the well-known 1980 photograph; date inferred

description: Close-up photograph, letterboxed and rotated sideways, of an IWC Schaffhausen chronograph wristwatch with a silver dial, blue hands and Arabic numerals lying on a blank lined notepad next to a black textured fountain pen. The dial's IWC branding and two chronograph sub-dials are visible, with a date window showing a numeral. This is one of the 'watch and pen' photos posted by Q, widely read as a marker/proof image.
flags: Interpretation as a Q marker/proof image is the community's claim, not established fact
